explication: RustFS is a distributed object-storage server: clients use S3 and other supported protocols to store or retrieve objects, which are managed by the storage engine and persisted across disks. Major documented capabilities include identity and encryption, lifecycle and replication, healing, notifications, and distributed operation. The tree and excerpts support these subsystem boundaries, but do not expose the full request handlers or their call sites, so links between several runtime subsystems are intentionally omitted.
